title: Whole-journey E2E: happy-path fixture + plant journeys project (testDir/path split against the same server)
recipe: SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md#7-test-scaffolding-work-items-named (T-6 tail — the test:e2e split; no whole-journey-E2E recipe exists: G-A step 7 territory, plan by exemplar transposition of e2e/journey-smoke.spec.js + e2e/live-animals-journey.js + playwright.config.js 'journeys' project)

filesToTouch.what: Whole-journey answers fixture, shape { "schema_version": 1, "values": { ... } } mirroring the live exemplar src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/fixtures/happy-path.json. Members (every value MUST resolve against the set's own fixture services — real canned data, never invented lookalikes): importType (the exact value the pp-017 import-type controller commits for CHED-PP — read it from sets/plant-products/journeys/linear/features/import-type/controller.js; flow-only key, included in values exactly as the live fixture includes its importType); countryOfOrigin + countryOfConsignment (real ISO-2 codes from services/reference/countries.js); internalReference (<=30 chars); reasonForImport 'INTERNAL_MARKET'; commodityInputMethod 'MANUAL'; commodityLines: ONE line carrying all ten leaf members (commoditySelection = a real commodity code from services/commodities/fixture.js, numberOfPackages, packageType code from services/reference/package-types.js, quantity, quantityType code from quantity-types.js, netWeight, controlledAtmosphereContainer, finishedOrPropagated, intendedForFinalUsers, testAndTrial) with nested species: ONE entry (eppoCode / genusAndSpecies / speciesId — real values for the chosen code) with nested varieties: ONE entry (variety = real variety ID, varietyClass valid per that species' class applicability in the commodities fixture) — full depth-3 per FD-9; totalGrossWeight (numeric, greater than the net weight so pp-028's cross-field rule passes), grossVolume + grossVolumeUnit (code from gross-volume-units.js); borderControlPost (real code from services/reference/bcps.js) + inspectionPremises (a control point valid for THAT BCP per the per-BCP map) + meansOfTransport (code from transport-options.js) + transportIdentification + transportDocumentReference + arrivalDate ({day,month,year} or the landed shape from pp-030) + arrivalTime + usesContainers true + containers: ONE entry (containerNumber, sealNumber, officialSeal); commonTransitConvention 'NO' (keeps movementReferenceNumber out of scope — its gate is covered by pp-031's page spec) + usingGvms false; responsiblePersonName / responsiblePersonEmail / responsiblePersonTelephone; accompanyingDocuments: ONE entry (documentType code from document-types.js, documentReference, issueDate {day,month,year}) satisfying the c-015 minEntries-1 floor; consignor leaves (consignorName, consignorAddressLine1, consignorCity, consignorPostcode, consignorCountry real code, plus email/telephone if pp-036's page requires them); destinationSameAsConsignee true (destination leaves stay out of scope); packer* omitted (optional). NOTE the location: MAPPING's brief abbreviates to journeys/linear/fixtures/ but the SIBLING-SET-PLAN §1 tree AND the live exemplar both place it under flow/fixtures/ — flow/fixtures/ is correct.

Add a fixture-driven completeness case mirroring live-animals flow/task-rows.test.js:25 (readFileSync(new URL('./fixtures/happy-path.json', import.meta.url))): load the fixture values, evaluate the rows, assert EVERY mandatory task row reports Completed, the nominated-contacts row is Optional and does not gate, and scope.readyForCheckYourAnswers is true — proving in unit-land that the fixture really closes the journey (guards the E2E suite against silent fixture drift).

Journey helper transposing e2e/live-animals-journey.js: export const { values } = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../src/server/app/sets/plant-products/journeys/linear/flow/fixtures/happy-path.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8')); **BASE = '/plant-products'** — and note the SYMMETRY (R7): the live-animals helper's own BASE is '/live-animals', migrated by pp-057 (§4.6 D), NOT '' as the round-2 plan assumed. Both helpers are prefixed, so this one is written prefixed FROM THE START and there is nothing to migrate here later. Every goto and URL match in this helper carries the prefix; journeyIdFromPage(page) FRONT-ANCHORS its regex on it — `new RegExp(\`^${BASE}/notifications/([^/]+)\`)` against the pathname, throwing when absent. A suffix-anchored or unanchored `/\/notifications\/([^/]+)/` would match either set's URL and would keep passing if the prefix were dropped, which proves nothing — same rule as §4.6 C and journeyUrl(page, slug); startNotification(page) — goto BASE ('/plant-products', the plant dashboard; a bare '/' 302s to '/live-animals' under FD-18 and would land the whole journey in the wrong set), click the dashboard's 'Create a new notification' button, complete the import-type filter with the CHED-PP option, continue into the opening run / hub per the landed pp-009/pp-017 behaviour; ONE fill-helper per mandatory hub spoke, each driving the real UI with fixture values and ending back at the hub: fillOrigin (country-of-origin + origin-of-import), fillPurpose (about-the-consignment), fillCommodities (manual branch: commodity-input-method MANUAL, commodity-search code pick, commodity-basic-description species add, variety-of-genus-and-species variety + class, commodity-summary continue, commodity-bulk-details measures), fillAdditionalDetails, fillTransport (incl. one container row), fillGoodsMovement, fillContact, addAccompanyingDocument, fillTraders (traders-addresses -> consignor-create -> consignor-confirmation 'Add to notification' -> back); plus completeAllMandatorySpokes(page) composing them in hub order. Where a value is a code, resolve its visible label through the SAME set fixture module the page uses (import from ../src/server/app/sets/plant-products/services/..., mirroring how live-animals-journey.js imports COUNTRY_LABELS/PORTS). If pp-030's arrival-date validation demands a current/future date, transpose the chooseTodayFromDatePicker pattern from live-animals-journey.js instead of the static fixture value. Raw role/label/visible-copy locators only, no page objects, auto-waiting assertions, never a sleep.

The whole-journey smoke spec (name deliberately does NOT match the existing journeys project's testMatch '**/journey-smoke.spec.js'). Two tests, each independent and starting its own notification: (1) 'full CHED-PP journey reaches confirmation' — startNotification, completeAllMandatorySpokes, open Review and submit, walk review-notification (spot-check at least one summary value per card family: an origin value, the commodity line's code/species/variety, a transport value, the document reference), continue to declaration, tick the attestation checkbox, 'Submit notification', assert the confirmation govuk-panel has an H1 and contains the GBN-PP reference captured via journeyIdFromPage/hub caption at journey start, and at least one asserted string is plant-set-only content that CANNOT render under live-animals (proves the /plant-products mount is served by the plant gateway); (2) 'review is locked until every mandatory row is complete' — start a notification, complete all mandatory spokes EXCEPT one (leave accompanying-documents empty so the c-015 floor bites), assert the hub shows no usable Review-and-submit link/that the review row is locked, assert a direct page.goto of the review-notification URL redirects away (entry-guard/section-gate behaviour), leave nominated-contacts empty throughout (proving the optional row never gates), then add the missing document and assert the review link becomes available. No axe checks here — per-page axe coverage lives in the co-located feature specs (pp-017..pp-040), matching the live exemplar which carries none.

Add a project to the projects array: { name: 'journeys-plant-products', testMatch: '**/plant-products-journey-smoke.spec.js', use: identical shape to the existing 'journeys' project (playwright.config.js:22-41 — Desktop Chrome, baseURL http://localhost:${port}, DEMO_SLOWMO-driven launchOptions.slowMo, video: 'on', trace: 'on') }. The plant journeys project shares the SAME HOST-ONLY baseURL as the live-animals journeys project — no set prefix appears in either project's baseURL (R7 §4.6 D): a baseURL ending in a set prefix would break /health, /signout and /public/*, and would make the other set unreachable from the same project. The prefix lives in each helper's BASE, nowhere else. It inherits the top-level testDir './e2e'. Existing 'journeys' project untouched (its testMatch cannot pick up the new file). webServer block UNTOUCHED — pp-011 already added PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE: 'stub' beside LIVE_ANIMALS_MODE: 'stub', so ONE server serves both sets on their stubs and this project simply drives the /plant-products path-space of that same server; reuseExistingServer: false stays. There is no served-set env var to pass through and no comment about env merging to write.

Add beside test:e2e (line 20): "test:e2e:plant-products": "npm run build:frontend && PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE=stub DEMO_SLOWMO=0 DEMO_PACE_MS=0 playwright test --project=journeys-plant-products". PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE selects the plant RECORDS STUB and nothing else; there is NO SERVED_SET (ruling R3 deleted it). Align the shape with the test:features:plant-products script pp-011 landed. Optionally also add "test:e2e:all" running --project=journeys --project=journeys-plant-products in one invocation, mirroring pp-011's test:features:all — decide at build time; if added it joins the ladder as the whole-journey co-residency proof.

specs: e2e/plant-products-journey-smoke.spec.js — test 1: full stub-mode CHED-PP journey (dashboard -> create -> import-type -> every mandatory spoke from the happy-path fixture -> review -> declaration -> confirmation panel with the GBN-PP reference); test 2: hub readiness gating (review locked + review-notification deep-link redirected while a mandatory row is incomplete; empty nominated-contacts never gates; review unlocks when the last mandatory row completes)
acceptanceCriteria: PORT=3050 npm run test:e2e:plant-products exits 0 self-hosting the app in stub mode (PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE=stub) — no backend, no workspace stack, no served-set env var, and the SAME server that serves live-animals at /live-animals (R7 — no set is at the root; / is a 302 to /live-animals per FD-18).

The whole journey runs entirely inside the /plant-products path-space: the helper's BASE is '/plant-products', every goto and URL assertion is prefixed, and no step touches a live-animals URL under /live-animals and none touches the bare / redirect.

The happy-path test drives the complete create -> fill-every-mandatory-spoke -> review -> declare -> confirmation run through the real UI; the confirmation assertion includes the govuk-panel H1 and the GBN-PP reference minted at journey start.

At least one assertion in the suite is plant-set content that cannot render under live-animals — under co-residency this proves the MOUNT (that /plant-products/… is served by the plant gateway), not an env pass-through.

Review and submit is unreachable while any mandatory row is incomplete: the hub exposes no usable review link AND a direct GET of review-notification redirects away; it unlocks exactly when the last mandatory row completes; an empty nominated-contacts row never gates (optional semantics).

happy-path.json holds only values that resolve against the set's fixture services (countries, commodities, BCPs + per-BCP control points, package/quantity/document/transport/gross-volume-unit codes); it exercises full depth-3 commodity nesting (1 line, 1 species, 1 variety with a valid class) and carries >=1 accompanying document (c-015 floor).
The new task-rows.test.js fixture case is green: every mandatory row Completed, nominated-contacts Optional, scope.readyForCheckYourAnswers true on the fixture values.

Existing suites are untouched and green: test:e2e (live-animals journeys project), test:features, test:features:plant-products, test:plant-products, npm test — with no test-count drop in any existing suite (recipe §8 tripwire). No live-animals spec is edited by this increment.

Two-sided verification in its co-residency form (this increment touches shared root config, so it is mandatory): src/server/app/co-residency.test.js is GREEN and PORT=3050 npm run test:features:all is GREEN — both sets serving correctly from ONE process. 'The other set still boots on its own env' is not the bar and no longer means anything.

notes:
AMENDED FOR RULING R7 (Sam, 2026-08-01, later session) — SYMMETRIC MOUNTS. The 'testDir/path split against the same server' description now applies SYMMETRICALLY: the live-animals journeys project's specs and its e2e/live-animals-journey.js helper are ALSO prefixed (pp-057 migrated them under §4.6 D, which the round-2 plan missed entirely), so this increment writes its plant equivalents prefixed FROM THE START rather than inventing the pattern. Concretely: e2e/plant-products-journey.js's BASE is '/plant-products' and e2e/live-animals-journey.js's is '/live-animals' — neither is ''; both helpers front-anchor their journey-id regex on their own base; and both journeys projects share the SAME HOST-ONLY baseURL, because a set-prefixed baseURL would break /health, /signout and /public/* and hide the other set. A bare page.goto('/') anywhere in the plant helper now 302s to /live-animals (FD-18) and silently runs the journey in the wrong set — call that out in review.

CROSS-REPO DEPENDENCY (R8): this increment is the IN-REPO whole-journey proof and it runs against the plant RECORDS STUB in a self-hosted server. It is NOT the cross-repo one. The whole-journey coverage against the real workspace stack — real backend, real Mongo, real OIDC — is pp-065 in repos/trade-imports-animals-tests, together with the set-neutral co-residency spec that can only exist there. Do not treat this increment as discharging that; §9 constraint 17 makes the tests-repo increment part of the milestone's definition of done.

AMENDED 2026-08-01 for Sam's ruling R3 (co-residency) — RETITLED, because the word 'split' carried a false premise. The round-1 framing assumed TWO SERVERS: one booted for live-animals, one booted with SERVED_SET=plant-products, with the whole-journey suites split between them. With one server serving both sets, the e2e split is a testDir/baseURL-PATH split only — same Playwright webServer, same port, same process; the plant journeys project just drives the /plant-products path-space. Consequences applied above: the helper's BASE becomes '/plant-products' (and, under R7, the live-animals helper's BASE is '/live-animals' — symmetric, neither empty); the script drops SERVED_SET and keeps PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE=stub, which selects the plant records stub and nothing else; the webServer block is untouched because pp-011 already added PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE beside LIVE_ANIMALS_MODE; and the plant-set-only assertion is now a MOUNT proof rather than an env-pass-through proof. ADDED TO ACCEPTANCE: this increment must additionally leave co-residency.test.js and test:features:all GREEN — it edits shared root config (playwright.config.js, package.json), so the two-sided check applies in its co-residency form. No live-animals spec is edited; the existing journeys project and test:e2e are untouched. An optional test:e2e:all (both journey projects in one invocation) is flagged as a build-time call, mirroring pp-011's test:features:all. ORIGINAL NOTES FOLLOW. Plan-born m4 closer: SIBLING-SET-PLAN §1 marks flow/fixtures/happy-path.json [m4] ('built when the journey closes') and §7 T-6 says 'Same split for test:e2e when the whole-journey plant suite exists (m4)'. Exemplars pinned live this session: playwright.config.js:22-41 ('journeys' project — testMatch '**/journey-smoke.spec.js', slowMo/video/trace), package.json:20 (test:e2e = build:frontend + DEMO_SLOWMO=0 DEMO_PACE_MS=0 + --project=journeys), e2e/journey-smoke.spec.js + e2e/live-animals-journey.js (helper reads the fixture at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/fixtures/happy-path.json:62-70 and exports { values } plus per-area fill helpers; chooseTodayFromDatePicker for current-date fields), live-animals flow/task-rows.test.js:25 + status.test.js:30 (unit consumers of the same fixture — the plant task-rows.test edit mirrors this). Fixture path decision: MAPPING's brief writes journeys/linear/fixtures/happy-path.json but both the plan's §1 tree and the live exemplar place it under flow/fixtures/ — flow/fixtures/ chosen. Fixture content rules applied: real canned data from the set's own fixture services only (workspace standing rule); commonTransitConvention 'NO' and destinationSameAsConsignee true keep gated branches out of the happy path (their gates are covered by pp-031/pp-035 page specs); usesContainers true exercises the containers group; declaration is NOT a fixture value — the spec ticks the checkbox (flow-only, FD-8, persisted at finalise per pp-039). Spec-file naming avoids the existing journeys project's testMatch so no config change to it is needed. This increment touches shared config (playwright.config.js, package.json), so the two-sided sibling-safety check (test:live-animals + the existing test:e2e journeys run) is in the ladder. No new copy, obligations, flow entries or schema fields — pure test/fixture/config work. Playwright best-practices: independent tests, raw role/label locators, no page objects, no sleeps, expect.poll only for non-locator state.
openQuestions: The exact committed importType value for CHED-PP is whatever pp-017's landed controller commits — the implementor must read it from the import-type controller and use it verbatim in the fixture; a mismatch shows up as the task-rows fixture case failing.

If pp-030's arrival-date validation requires a current/future date, the static fixture arrivalDate cannot drive the UI — the helper must transpose chooseTodayFromDatePicker from live-animals-journey.js and the fixture value becomes the unit-test-side value only; implementor checks the landed pp-030 validation before choosing.
